errors.genericDescription: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

contractErrors.pendingDescription: It was submitted but not confirmed yet, so it may still succeed. Check its status on Stellar Expert before trying again:

codes.ShipmentAlreadyExists: A shipment with this ID already exists. Reload the form to generate a new ID and try again.
codes.ShipmentNotFound: This shipment does not exist on-chain. Sync the shipment or check the ID.
codes.NotAuthorized: Your connected wallet is not allowed to perform this action on this shipment. Switch to the right account in Freighter.
codes.InvalidMilestoneIndex: This milestone does not exist on the shipment. Refresh the page and try again.
codes.InvalidMilestoneStatus: This milestone is not in the right state for this action. Refresh the page to see its latest status.
codes.ShipmentNotActive: This shipment is no longer active, so it cannot be changed.
codes.InvalidPercentages: Milestone payment percentages must add up to exactly 100%.
codes.InvalidAmount: The amount must be greater than zero.
codes.DisputeAlreadyOpen: A dispute is already open for this milestone. Wait for the arbiter to resolve it.
codes.InsufficientBalance: Your wallet does not have enough balance to cover this transaction. Top up and try again.
codes.InsufficientFee: The network fee was too low for this transaction. Please try again.
codes.BadSequence: Your account sequence number is out of date, usually because another transaction was sent at the same time. Please try again.
codes.TransactionExpired: The transaction expired before it reached the network. Please try again.
codes.NetworkBusy: The Stellar network is busy right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.UserRejected: You rejected the transaction in Freighter
codes.Unknown: The transaction could not be completed. Please try again, or share the technical details below with support.
